integrity: Exact proofs and standalone finite checks reported; finite enumeration is corroboration rather than proof of unrestricted theorem. No independent external audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Requires a nonempty finite world set, a total deterministic successor map, and full Boolean operations. The term-operation census is not an isomorphism classification and does not extend unmodified to relational/nondeterministic modalities. An implicit historical equivalent has not been excluded.
title: Divisor–tail skyline census of deterministic modal term operations
